items.quote: Several respondents noted that Rendo Ravell spearheaded the team's recovery after a major project setback at the national level.
Peers observed that Rendo Ravell set the direction for presentations to senior management across the public service.
Peers observed that Rendo championed adoption of new technology tools for case officers and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Rendo Ravell led process improvement in licensing operations across the department.
Several respondents noted that Rendo participated in engagement with industry stakeholders as a team member.
Rendo Ravell took ownership of teamwork across departments on the annual review and steered it to completion.
Rendo led a ten-year outlook for where the agency should be heading across the department.
Direct reports said that Rendo was recognised sector-wide for his leadership of mapping interdependencies across agencies.
Rendo Ravell set the direction for evidence-based evaluation of programme outcomes across the public service.
Several respondents noted that Rendo Ravell championed the organisational restructuring of the department and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Direct reports said that Rendo Ravell set the direction for efforts that helped three direct reports earn promotion across the public service.
